title: More Stews
description: Adds craftable stews with unique survival effects for Fabric
body:
# More Stews

More Stews adds five craftable Minecraft stew foods for Fabric, giving survival players more useful bowl-based meals with simple recipes and unique effects. It is a lightweight food and item mod for Minecraft 26.1.2, made for players who want more cooking, more stew recipes, and more reasons to use bowls in survival.

## Features

* **Noodles Stew** — a filling wheat-and-potion stew that gives short Regeneration.
* **Apple Stew** — a sweet apple stew with a Luck effect.
* **Tear Stew** — a ghast tear stew that gives Water Breathing for underwater exploring.
* **Banana Stew** — a fun yellow stew made with honey, apple, and yellow dye that gives Regeneration and Absorption.
* **Bloody Stew** — a rare healing stew made with glistering melon, beetroot, redstone, and a bowl.

## Why use it?

Vanilla Minecraft has only a few bowl foods. More Stews expands survival cooking with new craftable stews that are easy to understand, useful during exploration, and still feel close to vanilla gameplay. Each stew has its own texture, recipe, item name, and food effect, so it fits naturally into a survival world or lightweight Fabric modpack.

## Recipes

All stews are crafted in a crafting table or inventory crafting grid using a bowl plus themed ingredients:

| Stew         | Ingredients                                         | Effect                    |
| ------------ | --------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------- |
| Noodles Stew | Wheat + Water bottle + Bowl                         | Regeneration              |
| Apple Stew   | Apple + Sugar + Bowl                                | Luck                      |
| Tear Stew    | Ghast Tear + Water bottle + Bowl                    | Water Breathing           |
| Banana Stew  | Apple + Honey Bottle + Yellow Dye + Bowl            | Regeneration + Absorption |
| Bloody Stew  | Glistering Melon Slice + Beetroot + Redstone + Bowl | Instant Health            |

## Compatibility

* Minecraft: **26.1.2**
* Mod loader: **Fabric**
* Requires: **Fabric API**
* Multiplayer: install on both the server and every player client

This mod adds custom items and textures, so it is not server-only.

## Modpack permission

You may use More Stews in Modrinth modpacks as long as the downloaded file comes from this Modrinth project or follows the license included with the mod.
